plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Program page states the pathways are for catalog year 2026-2027 and the map is headed 'Transfer Pathway to CSUB map for 2026-2027'. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. This plan transcribes the first/default pathway, the Transfer Pathway to CSUB, Bakersfield College portion ONLY (Terms 1-4). The same page's CSU Bakersfield continuation (Philosophy - Law, Justice, & Social Policy Bachelor of Arts, 60 units, Terms 9-12) is a different institution's degree and is excluded. The program's other pathway, 'Philosophy to CSU' (also printed at 60-65 units, 4 terms), is a further pattern for the same AA-T credential, not a separate degree, and is not collected as a separate plan. The transcribed map prints the degree total as a range, 60-65 units, and term totals as 15-16.5 / 15-18.5 / 15 / 15. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 2 'Area 1B : Critical Thinking and Composition' (3-4), 'Area 2 : Mathematical Concepts and Quantitative Reasoning' (3-4.5) and 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' (3-4). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. The Term 1 'Philosophy or Ethics' slot is printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed' and is recorded as a major choice slot. No row on the Bakersfield College portion shows a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View, so no prereqs are recorded. General-education, major-list and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'This program map represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan that fits your needs.' The map also prints the footnote: 'Ready for the next step? Make an appointment with an advisor to create a customized education plan.'
